يغتصبون (form VIII)
# يَغْتَصِبُونَ (yaḡtaṣibūna) /jaɣ.ta.sˤi.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# يُغْتَصَبُونَ (yuḡtaṣabūna) /juɣ.ta.sˤa.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
